d: The Human Capital Executive is responsible for providing support in the various human resource functions, which include recruitment, staffing, training and development, performance monitoring and employee counseling.

The Human Capital Executive provides advice and assistance to supervisors and staff. This may include information on training needs and opportunities, job descriptions, performance reviews and personnel policies of the Council.

The position coordinates the staff recruitment process. The Human Capital Executive provides advice and support to supervisors and staff selection committees and ensures that they have accurate and timely information in order to make effective decisions.
q: The ideal Executive – Human Capital in a retail company should have 3+ years of progressive experience in human resource/HRMS/administration. Proven success in driving high level cross functional collaboration, enhancing customer engagement, and achieving & exceeding sales KPI targets for stores.
r: Support the onboarding process by preparing offer letters, collecting joining documents, and coordinating induction logistics.
Maintain accurate employee files (physical and digital) and update the HRMS with all relevant employee information and changes.
Ensure all new joiners are added to group systems (payroll, email, insurance) in coordination with relevant teams.
Handle day-to-day employee requests including employment letters, salary certificates, ID card issuance, and HR-related queries.
Assist in tracking attendance regularizations, shift changes, and leaves in coordination with the Admin and Operations teams.
Generate and maintain trackers for employee lifecycle activities such as confirmations, transfers, and resignations.
Assist in planning and executing employee events, birthday celebrations, and HR communication campaigns.
Support employee surveys by distributing forms, collecting responses, and preparing basic summary reports.
Maintain notice boards and internal communication channels with up-to-date HR information.
Prepare HR documents such as warning letters, promotion memos, and contract amendments under supervision.
Maintain HR registers and logs for audit purposes, ensuring timely filing and accuracy of records.
Share weekly/monthly reports related to headcount, leave balances, and employee changes as per formats provided.
Ensure adherence to internal SOPs, approval hierarchies, and documentation protocols for all HR tasks.
Participate in internal HR checks, audits, and compliance reviews by submitting required data and documents.
Raise any identified gaps or employee concerns to the Senior Executive or Assistant Manager promptly.
Liaise with Payroll, Admin, PRO, and IT teams to ensure seamless execution of employee-related transactions.
Follow up on pending approvals, documents, and system updates to ensure timely processing of HR actions.

d: Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others.
r: As a Merchant Field & Marketing Intern, you will be Tamara's on-ground representative across assigned partner stores. You will help ensure Tamara is visible, understood, and confidently recommended by store teams. This is a field role, not a desk role: you will spend most days visiting stores, building relationships, improving execution, gathering frontline insights, and reporting progress.

The internship is designed as a 90-day / 3-month programme. Performance will be reviewed weekly so interns receive timely feedback, clear priorities, and practical support to improve throughout the programme.

A formal progress assessment will take place at the end of the first 45 days. We want every intern to succeed and will provide regular guidance along the way. At the same time, consistent performance, reliability, quality of execution, and follow-through are essential to this field role. If performance at the 45-day assessment is not satisfactory, Tamara may conclude the internship at that stage rather than continue it through the full 90 days.
Visit assigned merchant stores according to a planned route and schedule
Check that Tamara signage, standees, counter cards, and other in-store materials are visible, accurate, current, and in good condition
Fix simple execution gaps and escalate missing materials, operational blockers, or recurring issues
Brief and retrain store managers, accountants, cashiers, and sales associates on how Tamara works and how to explain it clearly to customers
Build strong working relationships with store teams so Tamara remains visible and confidently recommended between visits
Maintain an accurate directory of key store contacts, including managers, finance contacts, checkout leads, and sales-floor leads
Gather anonymised frontline insight from store employees about customer questions, objections, checkout drop-off, competitor mentions, and opportunities to improve conversion
Capture approved photos and short videos for Tamara's marketing and UGC-style content
Log every visit, including tasks completed, employees met, staff trained, issues found, insights gathered, evidence captured, and follow-up actions
Submit a weekly report summarising store coverage, improvements, risks, recurring insights, and priorities for the following week
Score stores against Tamara's evaluation framework and track progress from the current state to the target state
Outgoing and comfortable entering unfamiliar stores and starting conversations with new people
Polished, professional, and confident representing Tamara to merchant partners
A strong communicator who can explain a financial product simply and clearly
Genuinely interested in Tamara's brand, values, customers, and merchant experience
Reliable, organised, and disciplined about schedules, reporting, and follow-through
Curious and observant, with the ability to identify patterns in customer and employee feedback
Comfortable capturing good-quality photo and video on a phone
Able to commit to at least 5 hours per day, 6 days per week, for the duration of the internship
Has reliable means of travelling between assigned store locations
Quality and consistency of in-store Tamara visibility
Number of store employees trained and improvement in their Tamara knowledge
Speed and quality of issue identification, escalation, and resolution
Completeness of the store contact directory
Quality of daily visit logs and weekly reports
Usefulness of consumer and employee insights gathered
Quantity and quality of approved content captured
Improvement in store evaluation scores over time
Represent Tamara professionally and respect merchant operating hours
Secure approval before capturing any in-store content
Do not photograph or record customers without approved consent
Keep merchant and employee contact details in approved Tamara systems only
Report facts and recurring patterns clearly, and escalate urgent merchant, customer, compliance, or brand risks on the same day

d: Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent Engineering discipline.
Minimum 15 years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
Minimum 10 years of experience in brownfield Oil & Gas project engineering roles within multidisciplinary project teams.
Significant experience delivering Well Pads EPCM Projects.
Proven experience in engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, and project delivery of upstream Oil & Gas facilities.
Strong understanding of Well Pads development, wellsite facilities, flowlines, manifolds, gathering systems, utility systems, and associated infrastructure.
Experience managing multidisciplinary engineering and project delivery teams within EPCM project environments.
Strong understanding of project execution methodologies, risk management, cost control, and schedule management.
Experience supporting commissioning, start-up, and operational handover activities.
Excellent communication, technical coordination, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Experience working in multicultural and multidisciplinary project environments.
Demonstrated commitment to HSSE leadership and project delivery excellence.
Maintain a strong HSSE focus to ensure health, safety, environmental, and process safety requirements are incorporated into engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities.
Build and maintain strong stakeholder and customer relationships.
Proactively resolve performance, scope, technical, and schedule issues as they arise.
Identify, document, communicate, and deliver project requirements effectively.
Effectively manage assigned project budgets and forecast costs within areas of responsibility.
Apply project change management processes effectively to ensure governance and control.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of integrated EPCM project schedules.
Supervise engineering and project execution activities in accordance with approved milestones and schedules.
Monitor project costs, identify trends, and implement corrective actions to avoid cost overruns.
Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, project requirements, and industry standards.
Maintain strong knowledge of engineering, procurement, construction management, and commissioning processes.
Focus project teams on achieving milestones, project objectives, and performance targets.
Facilitate teamwork, remove roadblocks, and support successful project execution.
Maintain effective communication with engineering teams, contractors, suppliers, and stakeholders.
Provide accurate, timely, and effective progress reporting to Project Management and stakeholders.
Monitor the closure of project risks, action items, and opportunities.
Set clear objectives for engineering teams, including productivity, quality, schedule, and budget targets.
Ensure engineering teams comply with the approved Basis of Design, project specifications, applicable regulations, and industry codes.
Manage multidisciplinary interfaces effectively across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operations teams.
Assess procurement activities to ensure equipment and materials meet specifications, are delivered on time, and remain within budget.
Ensure effective coordination between construction, procurement, engineering, and commissioning teams.

Demonstrate strong technical knowledge of Well Pads EPCM projects, including wellsite infrastructure, gathering systems, flowlines, manifolds, utility networks, and upstream production support facilities.

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
r: Provide strong HSSE leadership and promote a culture of safety, integrity, and operational excellence.
Plan, coordinate, and manage the engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities associated with Well Pads EPCM projects.
Ensure clear alignment and agreement of project objectives with stakeholders and ensure project requirements are met or exceeded.
Support the successful delivery of Well Pads projects, including wellsite facilities, wellhead infrastructure, flowlines, manifolds, utility systems, access roads, and associated infrastructure.
Ensure KPIs and project performance objectives are achieved through effective leadership, coordination, and stewardship of multidisciplinary teams.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
Prepare Project Service Proposals, Project Execution Plans, and EPCM project delivery strategies.
Maintain day-to-day interaction with the Project Manager and stakeholders to monitor engineering progress, project performance, schedule, cost, and commercial matters.
Organize and facilitate Design Reviews, 3D Model Reviews, HAZOPs, HAZIDs, Constructability Reviews, Value Engineering Workshops, and other technical meetings required to deliver Well Pads projects.
Follow up and close mitigation actions to ensure risks are reduced to ALARP principles.
Adhere to Project Management of Change (MoC) procedures to maintain design integrity and effectively manage scope, cost, and schedule changes.
Assist Project Controls in preparing project estimates, forecasts, schedules, and progress reports.
Chair model reviews and technical review meetings with project stakeholders and multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Organize and participate in risk workshops to identify, assess, document, and mitigate project risks and opportunities.
Support HSSE teams in preparing Job Safety Assessments (JSA), risk assessments, and work execution plans.
Review engineering drawings, specifications, and discipline deliverables to identify scope variances and support variation management processes.
Coordinate and communicate project objectives and technical requirements across multidisciplinary engineering, procurement, and construction teams.
Review procurement packages, technical bid evaluations, subcontract documentation, and provide recommendations for award.
Assist in the preparation of Scopes of Work (SOW) for contractors, suppliers, and service providers.
Coordinate technical query resolution and support timely procurement of long-lead equipment and materials.
Coordinate technical document reviews and approvals with discipline specialists and engineering authorities.
Coordinate lessons learned activities and contribute to project completion and close-out reports.
Deliver excellence in HSSE, quality, and process safety throughout all phases of project execution.

Support the engineering and execution of Well Pads facilities, including wellheads, flowlines, manifolds, gathering systems, utility systems, road networks, fencing, telecommunications, and associated infrastructure.
Ensure all engineering and EPCM activities comply with applicable project specifications, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and company procedures.

d: Welcome to MultiBank Group, a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.

Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering our clients to achieve their financial goals.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Cyber Security Engineer to join our Technology division. This is a hands-on, technical role requiring deep experience across SIEM, EDR, PAM, DLP, cloud security, firewalls, identity management, threat detection, and incident response. Experience in the Cryptocurrency industry is a key requirement for this role.

You will play a critical role in defending the organization, strengthening our security posture, conducting advanced threat hunting, automating operational workflows, and ensuring the secure operation of MultiBank's global systems. The ideal candidate is technically strong, proactive, structured, and able to perform in a fast-paced environment.
q: At least 6 years of experience in cybersecurity engineering or security operations roles.
Proven experience in the Cryptocurrency industry (e.g., crypto exchanges, trading platforms, or digital asset custody/wallet providers), including familiarity with crypto-specific security risks.
SIEM tools such as Azure Sentinel or QRadar
EDR/XDR platforms like Microsoft Defender or CrowdStrike
DLP platforms including Forcepoint, Microsoft Purview, or Symantec
Firewalls/IPS/WAF technologies (Fortinet, Palo Alto, F5, Cisco, Forcepoint)
Identity & Access Management (SSO/MFA, conditional access, IAM)
Hands-on experience with multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP) and CSPM tools.
Strong scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, ISO 27001:2022, and NIST CSF frameworks.
Experience with threat intelligence feeds and proactive threat hunting.
Certifications such as SC-200, SC-100, CISA, CCNP Security, or equivalent.
Understanding of modern security architectures including Zero Trust, SASE, and SDP.
Exposure to red team / blue team exercises.
Passion for building secure, scalable, and reliable systems.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights.
r: Administer, tune, and optimize SIEM platforms (Azure Sentinel, QRadar), including alert rules, dashboards, KQL queries, and automated playbooks.
Manage Microsoft Defender across endpoints, servers, and cloud workloads.
Conduct advanced threat hunting using SIEM, EDR, and cloud telemetry.
Build and maintain incident response playbooks integrated with SOAR tools.
Implement and manage SSO, MFA, conditional access, and Zero Trust policies.
Deploy, monitor, and optimize Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions such as Delinea, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, or ARCOS.
Conduct regular access reviews and enforce strict RBAC controls.
Deploy and manage enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions across endpoints, email, and cloud.
Implement and maintain data classification, labeling, and encryption frameworks.
Manage firewalls, IPS, WAF, and web filtering/proxy systems (Fortinet, Palo Alto, F5, Cisco, Forcepoint).
Harden servers, network devices, and cloud workloads according to best practices.
Implement segmentation and intrusion prevention measures.
Conduct vulnerability scanning, patch validation, and attack surface assessments.
Collaborate with IT, DevOps, and Platform teams on remediation activities.
Develop automation scripts using Python, PowerShell, or Bash for threat detection, monitoring, and response.
Integrate security tools into SOAR workflows to increase operational efficiency.
Support business continuity documentation, testing, and processes.
Maintain effective relationships with key vendors and external partners.
x: Work with an industry-leading global financial institution.
Competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
Collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment.
Commitment to innovation and professional excellence.
Become part of our international community at MultiBank Group, dedicated to excellence, innovation, and shaping the future of finance.
